name: Bake material graphs into the game
body: `mist run materials` (and the editor on save, and the content watcher) writes `game-assets/materials/<name>.frag` from each material Silhouette with a `material.graph.json`, compiles it to `.spv` and `.msl` beside it, and adds `lantern:::world:::SetMaterialShader(material, shaderName, textures)` to `BakedMaterials.nyx`. The packaged game carries only the compiled shaders; `the-game-materials-are-built-and-current` also checks the generated GLSL.

comments.text: Built: mist run materials generates each material graph's GLSL into game-assets/materials, compiles it to .frag.spv and .frag.msl with glslangValidator and spirv-cross, and BakedMaterials.nyx loads it with the new lantern:::world:::SetMaterialShader host call. Sample: painted_metal. Package drops the graph and .frag. D-261.
